name: agent-dag-workflow
description: Discover, run, diagnose, and author durable Agent DAG workflows from Codex without loading every workflow into context.

interface.shortDescription: Run durable DAG workflows with low context overhead.
interface.longDescription: Uses an on-demand Skill and the agent-workflow CLI to discover, execute, diagnose, and author durable Agent DAG workflows. A fixed MCP Gateway remains optional for hosts without local command execution.
defaultPrompt: Find and run the best workflow for this task.
Build and validate a reusable DAG workflow.
Diagnose this workflow run from its trace.
